style: Editorial photograph, low-key lighting, deep black background, warm light falling from above out of frame (no visible lamp), brass and dark iron tones, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, cinematic. Clean surfaces with no writing, no lettering, no logos.

events.break-the-case: A dark boardroom table at night under one pendant lamp: open case binders, loose sheets with hand-drawn boxes and arrows, a fountain pen, a coffee cup, two pairs of hands pointing at the same sheet.
events.robowars: Two low, heavy wheeled combat robots, flat armoured boxes with a spinning steel blade and a wedge, colliding on a steel arena floor behind scratched polycarbonate walls, a fan of orange sparks spraying from the impact.
events.wall-street-business: A dark walnut desk with a leather notebook, a fountain pen, a stack of bound reports and a brass desk lamp, city lights blurred through the window behind.
events.astro-datathon: A laptop open on a rooftop at night, its glow on the hands at the keyboard, a small telescope beside it and a sky dense with stars above.
events.analytics-datathon: Printed scatter plots and bar charts spread across a dark desk, a hand holding a highlighter over one of them, a laptop glowing out of focus behind.
events.pit-trading: A crowded trading pit seen from above, raised hands flashing signals, paper order slips in the air, hard overhead light falling on the crowd.
events.hackathon: A long table of laptops at three in the morning, tangled charging cables, coffee cups and cans, several pairs of hands typing, screens glowing out of focus.
events.mech-ideathon: Pencil sketches of gears and linkages on drafting paper, a brass vernier caliper, a mechanical pencil and a small 3D-printed gear prototype resting on the drawing.
events.wall-street-analytics: A trading desk at night with three monitors showing green and red candlestick charts out of focus, a hand resting on the mouse in the foreground.
events.anatomy-of-murder: A detective's evidence wall of pinned photographs connected by red string and thumbtacks, a magnifying glass and a fingerprint card on the desk below.
events.trick-of-trade: An old brass merchant's balance scale weighing a pile of coins against a small sack of spices, an open ledger book beside it.
events.cruxipher: A sealed envelope with a red wax seal, a brass cipher wheel, a magnifying glass and scattered puzzle pieces on a dark wooden desk.
events.coinquest: A stack of brass coins engraved with circuit-board patterns, one coin standing on its edge, on a dark stone surface.
events.arthasastra: An ancient Indian palm-leaf manuscript bound with cord, a few worn copper coins and a lit brass oil lamp on a dark cloth.
events.coding-contest: Close-up of a mechanical keyboard with a hand mid-keystroke, a monitor of syntax-highlighted code blurred behind, a stopwatch at the edge of the desk.
events.enigma: Close-up of a vintage rotor cipher machine: brass rotor wheels, round keyboard keys and a panel of small lamps, one lamp lit.
events.bulls-and-brains: A small bronze bull statue on a desk beside a chessboard mid-game, a knight lifted between two fingers.
events.blitz-cup: Hands typing at speed on a keyboard with motion blur, a mechanical stopwatch in sharp focus beside the keyboard.
events.defuse-the-bomb: A prop time-bomb box on a table with tangled red, blue and yellow wires, a pair of wire cutters hovering over one wire, a small red LED readout.
events.agent-competition: Several small brass robot figurines standing on a chessboard-like grid, each facing a different direction, like pieces in a game.
events.fifa-auction: A wooden auction gavel resting on a football on a dark pitch under a stadium floodlight.
events.concrete-bowling: A rough handmade concrete bowling ball rolling down a polished lane toward a set of pins, dust trailing behind it.
events.escape-room: A heavy vintage wooden door hung with padlocks and chains, a flashlight beam crossing it, a ring of old keys and a small combination-lock box on the floor.
events.ecosnap: Hands holding a camera close to a fern leaf with dew drops, a forest floor dark behind, a single shaft of light.
events.ai-slop-slayer: A magnifying glass held over a printed photograph of a human hand that has six fingers, a red pen beside it on the desk.
events.last-autopsy: A stainless steel forensic lab tray with scalpels, forceps and capped specimen vials under a round surgical lamp.
events.arg: An old payphone booth at night, a cassette tape and a torn map left on its shelf, a flashlight beam finding them.
events.cubing: A scrambled speed cube with bright coloured stickers mid-turn in a hand over a speed-stacking timer mat, motion blur on the turning layer.
events.prompt-lab: Hands on a laptop keyboard in a dark room, a small brass robot-arm model beside the laptop, the screen glow lighting both.
events.card-counting: A blackjack table: playing cards fanned across green felt, stacks of casino chips, a dealer's hand turning a card.
events.ti-workshop: A red microcontroller development board on a breadboard with jumper wires, a tiny green LED lit, a USB cable trailing off.
events.model-rocketry: A model rocket lifting off its launch rail at dusk, a bright exhaust flame and a plume of white smoke.
events.pcb-workshop: Hands soldering a green printed circuit board with a fine iron, a thin wisp of solder smoke rising under a lamp.
events.quantum-computing: The gold-plated tiers of a quantum computer's dilution refrigerator, stacked plates wound with coaxial cables, lit from above.
events.machine-learning: Close-up of a graphics card's heatsink fins and fan, a laptop behind it showing a falling loss curve out of focus.
events.analog-electronics: An oscilloscope showing a clean sine wave beside a breadboard of op-amps, resistors and probes clipped on.
events.digital-design: An FPGA development board with a row of red LEDs lit, logic chips and a ribbon cable, on a dark workbench.
events.exoplanet-detection: A dark planet silhouetted as it crosses in front of a glowing star, seen through the round field of a telescope eyepiece.
events.etch-a-sketch: Hands turning the two white knobs of a red drawing toy, a fine continuous line drawing on its grey screen.
events.aroma-workshop: Hand-poured candles in small glass jars, a few amber perfume bottles and dried flowers, one candle lit.
events.semiconductor: A silicon wafer with an iridescent grid of chips, held at its edge by tweezers in a cleanroom glove.
events.perfume: Glass perfume bottles, pipettes and small beakers of essential oils on a lab bench, a drop falling from a pipette.
events.stargazing: A telescope on a tripod in a dark open field under the Milky Way, a silhouetted figure looking through the eyepiece.
events.solar-gazing: A telescope fitted with a solar filter pointed at a low sun, two silhouetted figures beside it at sunrise.
events.f1-simrig: A racing simulator cockpit: a carbon steering wheel, a bucket seat and three curved screens showing a blurred racetrack.
events.rage-room: A sledgehammer mid-swing smashing an old television and a stack of plates, shards flying, a dark room.
events.arcade-machine: Close-up of a retro arcade cabinet's joystick and round buttons, the screen glowing out of focus above.
events.period-pain-simulator: A small electrical stimulator unit with its adhesive electrode pads and wires laid out on a clinic table beside a hot water bottle.
events.chemistry-casino: Stacks of casino chips on green felt beside conical flasks of brightly coloured liquids and a pair of dice.
events.tech-tiranga: A swarm of lit drones in the night sky arranged in three horizontal bands of saffron, white and green.
events.auto-expo: The chrome grille and a round headlamp of a classic car in a dark showroom, a single spotlight from above.
